title: Microsoft Teams: open channels at your last read message on desktop and Mac
summary: Hold: the roadmap describes a user choice, but does not establish that channels will continue opening at the newest message until users change it. The briefing also turns an undocumented admin control into an unsupported assurance that no admin role is needed, and overstates what is known about data access and actions. The roadmap details, product-level licensing and absence of a documented feature-specific admin switch checked out.

claims.where: Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Channels keep opening at the most recent message until a user chooses otherwise, so only users who opt in notice a change.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Teams channels "last read" default newest messages permissions actions; Microsoft Teams "579890" default role licensing. Read roadmap and Teams settings reference; user choice is stated, but the initial selection and unchanged default are not.
claims.fix: Replace 'If nobody acts, the roadmap's wording indicates that channels keep opening at the most recent message until a user chooses otherwise' with 'The roadmap presents this as a user choice but does not state which opening position is selected on arrival.' Remove 'so expect channel behaviour to change only for people who opt in.' Replace the impact rationale with 'Low. The roadmap describes a user choice on Desktop and Mac; the opening position selected on arrival is not stated.'
